name: Cutistic Gifts
subtitle: Custom Gifting E-Commerce & Shopify Sales
challenge: Restore unrecorded purchase attribution following iOS privacy updates, eliminate attribution loss in Meta Ads Manager, and scale direct Shopify store orders profitably during festive and seasonal gifting peaks.
approach: Server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) direct integration with Shopify webhooks to capture 100% of purchase events.
Dynamic product catalogue integration with automated retargeting for abandoned checkout visitors.
Bespoke product personalization video reels demonstrating customization quality and unboxing emotion.
High-urgency Diwali festive campaign creative testing with tiered gift hampers and countdown angles.
Advantage+ Shopping campaigns (ASC) paired with custom high-AOV purchaser lookalikes.
result: Generated ₹7.45L in verified campaign revenue with an exceptional 4.60x Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and 840 purchases at an average CPA of ₹192.

strategies.title: 01 SERVER-SIDE CAPI & PIXEL DUAL TRACKING
strategies.description: Connected Shopify backend webhooks directly to Meta Graph API, restoring lost orders caused by browser ad-blockers and achieving an Event Match Quality score above 8.5/10.

strategies.title: 02 DYNAMIC PRODUCT CATALOGUE ADS (DPA)
strategies.description: Synced 50+ personalized gifting SKUs with Meta catalogue ads, showing exact personalized designs to users who viewed products or abandoned carts.

strategies.title: 03 PRODUCT CUSTOMIZATION VIDEO REELS
strategies.description: Produced engaging short-form video creative showing laser engraving, artisan crafting, and finished unboxing to build instant product value.

strategies.title: 04 DIWALI FESTIVE CAMPAIGN SCALING
strategies.description: Created dedicated festive gifting hampers with guaranteed delivery date guarantees, capitalizing on peak corporate and personal gifting seasons.

strategies.title: 05 ADVANTAGE+ SHOPPING CAMPAIGN (ASC)
strategies.description: Scaled broad-match AI bidding with creative diversity (video reels, square static, carousel banners) to discover lowest CPA audiences pan-India.

keyLearnings: Product demonstration videos showing the actual laser engraving and customisation process achieved a 3.2x higher conversion rate than static packshots.
Setting up Meta Conversions API (CAPI) recaptured 28% of previously unrecorded purchase events, immediately improving algorithm optimization.
Diwali festive angles generated ₹3.2L in revenue in just 14 days with strong average order values (AOV).
Dynamic product ads retargeting 7-day cart abandoners achieved an outstanding 6.4x ROAS.
